value: OPEN — automated audit generated in this run
engineering_basis: The historical 610.3/915.4 MPa result belongs to an older load/methodology version. The current authoritative Phase 1 envelope is revised/restructured, and the current axle source uses nominal root axial+bending+torsion stress with no explicit Kt/SCF. The current 50x8 mm row is 320.772903 MPa limit and 481.159355 MPa ultimate, governing at LC2A.
limitation_or_validation: Historical LC4 reconstruction requires effective bending Kt=1.198061 to reproduce 610.3 MPa. This strongly explains the old result but does not prove the exact historical code implementation. The old result is retained only as provenance, not as a current regression target.
